checklist.title: Can ENR values violate the no-fork invariant by setting incorrect next_fork_version or next_fork_epoch when no fork is planned?

reachability.notes: Incorrect no-fork ENR values could cause premature peering disconnects.

checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify the code path that sets ENR fork digest values when no future fork is scheduled. 2. Verify that when no fork is planned, next_fork_version is set exactly equal to current_fork_version. 3. Verify that when no fork is planned, next_fork_epoch is set to FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH (0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF). 4. Attempt to trigger state transitions where fork schedule changes from 'fork planned' to 'no fork planned' and verify ENR values are correctly updated. 5. Check for race conditions where ENR could be served with stale fork values during configuration changes. 6. Test edge cases: a) Fork just completed (verify proper reset), b) Fork cancelled before activation, c) Client restart with no pending forks.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0043, Invariant: p2p-SG-012-INV-003, Primary Element: p2p-SG-012. This invariant ensures proper ENR advertisement when no fork is scheduled. Violation could cause peers to incorrectly assess fork compatibility, leading to unnecessary disconnections or failed peering attempts.
